description: Search indexed functions and components. Actions: query (natural language + operators like entity:, component:, hook:, dep:, calls:, lang:, complexity:, exported:, jsdoc:, file:, unused-imports, name:), definition (exact function/component lookup).

action.description: Action to perform. One of: query, definition.

filePath.description: Optional file path to narrow search.

filters.description: Optional filters (language, filePath, dependencies, componentType, entityType, searchMode).

name.description: Function or component name to find.

query.description: Search query with natural language and/or operators. Examples: "Button component:functional", "calls:validateUser", "unused-imports".

name: search
